elements.text:
Meewano was created from a simple observation: exploring Kurdistan should be easier, and finding a place to stay should not be a source of
uncertainty or frustration.

The idea was inspired by the experience of travellers struggling to find reliable holiday accommodation through personal recommendations,
social media and informal networks. Prices often required lengthy negotiation, availability was unpredictable, and it was difficult to know whether
a property would truly match its description.

There was also a lack of clear information for guests — from property instructions and local guidance to what they could expect on arrival —
while hosts could be hesitant to accept guests due to a lack of trust and reliable information.

Meewano brings hosts and guests together through a dedicated accommodation marketplace, Meewano is creating a simpler, clearer and more
trusted way to stay in Kurdistan.

Our vision is simple: make hosting easier, and help people explore Kurdistan with confidence

Within 24 Hours of Booking and check in is more than 7 days away.  
>Full refund.
Reason: People make mistakes.

More Than 30 Days Before Check-in
>Full refund.
Reason: Host has plenty of time to rebook.

14–30 Days Before Check-in
>90% refund.
Host keeps 10%.
Reason: Host may suffer some loss.

50% refund.
Reason: Risk is shared fairly.

Less Than 7 Days Before Check-in
No refund unless:
Property rebooks
Host voluntarily agrees
Exceptional circumstances apply


Exceptional Circumstances:
Full refund if:
Death of immediate family member
Serious illness with evidence
Government travel ban
War or civil unrest
Natural disaster

*Cancellation causes Meewano loss due to payment fees, 
later when business grows, include payment fees

elements.text:
When a guest books on Booking.com with a cash-on-arrival option and
fails to turn up (a "no-show"), the host must mark the reservation as a
no-show in the extranet to avoid paying commission, while Booking.com
charges no commission for that cancelled stay once reported. [1]
elements.originalText: When a guest books on Booking.com with a cash-on-arrival option and fails to turn up (a "no-show"), the host must mark the reservation as a no-show in the extranet to avoid paying commission, while Booking.com charges no commission for that cancelled stay once reported. [1]

elements.text:
* Marking the No-Show: The host must log into the Booking.com Extranet
and mark the guest as a "no-show" (usually available starting from the
check-in date). [2]
elements.originalText: * Marking the No-Show: The host must log into the Booking.com Extranet and mark the guest as a "no-show" (usually available starting from the check-in date). [2]

elements.text:
* Commission Charges: If marked correctly as a no-show, the host does
not pay commission to Booking.com for the uncollected revenue. [3]
elements.originalText: * Commission Charges: If marked correctly as a no-show, the host does not pay commission to Booking.com for the uncollected revenue. [3]

elements.text:
* Loss of Income & Room Availability: The host loses the expected
revenue for that night and often could not sell the room to someone else
because it was held.
elements.originalText: * Loss of Income & Room Availability: The host loses the expected revenue for that night and often could not sell the room to someone else because it was held.

elements.text:
* Fee Collection Limitations: If the booking relied strictly on cash
with no valid credit card provided or pre-authorization set up, the host
generally cannot collect any no-show or cancellation fees from the
guest. [2]
elements.originalText: * Fee Collection Limitations: If the booking relied strictly on cash with no valid credit card provided or pre-authorization set up, the host generally cannot collect any no-show or cancellation fees from the guest. [2]

elements.text:
* Commission Waiver: Booking.com will waive the commission fee for that
specific reservation once the property officially marks it as a no-show
in their system. [4, 5]
elements.originalText: * Commission Waiver: Booking.com will waive the commission fee for that specific reservation once the property officially marks it as a no-show in their system. [4, 5]

elements.text:
* Guest Accountability: Booking.com tracks guest no-shows. If a guest
repeatedly fails to show up without cancelling, Booking.com may issue a
warning or eventually close/restrict the guest's account.
elements.originalText: * Guest Accountability: Booking.com tracks guest no-shows. If a guest repeatedly fails to show up without cancelling, Booking.com may issue a warning or eventually close/restrict the guest's account.
